title: Anti-commuting Solutions of the Yang-Baxter-like Matrix Equation for Identity Matrix Minus Special Rank-three Matrices
content: Suppose \( A=I-PQ^T, \) where both \( P \)and \( Q \) are  \( n\times 3 \) complex matrices and det\( (Q^T P)\neq 0 \). By analyzing the Jordan canonical form of the coefficient matrix \( A, \) we find all the anti-commuting  solutions \( X, \) which satisfy \( AX=-XA, \) of the Yang-Baxter-like matrix equation(YBME) \( AXA=XAX \).
